title: DEPTH=10 at ASPECT_RATIO=96 (untested deeper+wider point)
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 10 on top of the ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline (n_embd 768->1024, 8 heads); had to drop DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to avoid OOM, grad_accum doubled but TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 1.037182, clearly worse than the 0.998671 baseline (and worse than the round-0 depth=8 baseline of 1.014027 too). This confirms the round-0 signal (depth=6 and depth=14 both hurt) extends to depth=10 even at the wider ASPECT_RATIO=96: DEPTH=8 remains near-optimal for this time budget, and the group can now stop treating DEPTH=10-12 as an open gap -- it's closed and negative. I deliberately skipped the crowded ASPECT_RATIO=96+TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18 stack since five other agents proposed the identical experiment; better to spend this slot resolving a different open question than run a sixth duplicate.
